summary: Recent discussions in the Parquet community focus on extending the format with a logical VECTOR type, proposing a two‑tier versioning strategy, and rallying contributors for new encodings. The community also noted the upcoming 1.19.0 release.

highlights.text: Introducing a logical VECTOR type with MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH metadata constraints to represent fixed‑size vectors

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Numeric Vector type: physical representation (outcome of focused call)

highlights.text: Proposing a two‑tier approach to Parquet format changes: add‑everywhere changes that are forward compatible and compatibility‑level changes
Recruiting contributors to add new encodings such as pcode, FSST, and PFOR
